title: Speak Like You're Playing a Video Game

cues.text: For the past 20 years,
cues.en: For the past 20 years,
cues.zh: 過去 20 年來

cues.text: I've been helping Malaysian and other Southeast Asians
cues.en: I've been helping Malaysian and other Southeast Asians
cues.zh: 我一直在教馬來西亞人和東南亞人

cues.text: to speak better English.
cues.en: to speak better English.
cues.zh: 如何增進英文口說能力

cues.text: And through training thousands of Southeast Asians,
cues.en: And through training thousands of Southeast Asians,
cues.zh: 透過訓練數以千計的東南亞人

cues.text: I've discovered a very surprising truth.
cues.en: I've discovered a very surprising truth.
cues.zh: 我發現了驚人的事實

cues.text: I've discovered that how well somebody communicates in English
cues.en: I've discovered that how well somebody communicates in English
cues.zh: 我發現一個人的英文溝通能力

cues.text: actually has very little to do with their English level.
cues.en: actually has very little to do with their English level.
cues.zh: 其實跟他的英文程度幾乎無關

cues.text: It has a lot to do with their attitude towards English.
cues.en: It has a lot to do with their attitude towards English.
cues.zh: 而是跟他說英文的態度息息相關

cues.text: There are people out there who have a very low level of English,
cues.en: There are people out there who have a very low level of English,
cues.zh: 有些人的英文程度很差

cues.text: and they can communicate very, very well.
cues.en: and they can communicate very, very well.
cues.zh: 卻能用英文清楚表達想法

cues.text: One of them that I remember was a student, a participant of mine named Faizal.
cues.en: One of them that I remember was a student, a participant of mine named Faizal.
cues.zh: 我的課上有個學生叫做法扎爾

cues.text: He was a factory supervisor -
cues.en: He was a factory supervisor -
cues.zh: 他是工廠的主管

cues.text: English level very, very low -
cues.en: English level very, very low -
cues.zh: 英文程度非常非常的差

cues.text: but this guy could just sit and listen to anybody,
cues.en: but this guy could just sit and listen to anybody,
cues.zh: 但他能坐下來聽取任何人的意見

cues.text: very calmly, clearly,
cues.en: very calmly, clearly,
cues.zh: 冷靜沉著，清楚聽著

cues.text: and then he could respond,
cues.en: and then he could respond,
cues.zh: 接著回應

cues.text: absolutely express his thoughts beautifully,
cues.en: absolutely express his thoughts beautifully,
cues.zh: 精準到位表達他的想法

cues.text: at a very low level of English.
cues.en: at a very low level of English.
cues.zh: 僅用程度很低的英文能力

cues.text: So, today I want to share with you
cues.en: So, today I want to share with you
cues.zh: 今天我想跟大家分享

cues.text: what is so different about people like Faizal?
cues.en: what is so different about people like Faizal?
cues.zh: 像法扎爾這種人的獨特之處在哪？

cues.text: How do they do it?
cues.en: How do they do it?
cues.zh: 他們是怎麼做到的？

cues.text: And second of all,
cues.en: And second of all,
cues.zh: 還有就是

cues.text: why is this so important not only to you,
cues.en: why is this so important not only to you,
cues.zh: 為什麼這件事不僅對你很重要

cues.text: but to your children, to your community, and to the future of Malaysia?
cues.en: but to your children, to your community, and to the future of Malaysia?
cues.zh: 也對你的孩子、你的社群 以及馬來西亞的未來很重要？

cues.text: And third of all,
cues.en: And third of all,
cues.zh: 再來

cues.text: what's one thing you can do, starting today,
cues.en: what's one thing you can do, starting today,
cues.zh: 你可以做一件事，就從今天開始

cues.text: if you want to speak with that calm, clear confidence
cues.en: if you want to speak with that calm, clear confidence
cues.zh: 如果想以沉著自信的態度說英文

cues.text: that people like Faizal have.
cues.en: that people like Faizal have.
cues.zh: 就像法扎爾一樣

cues.text: First of all,
cues.en: First of all,
cues.zh: 首先

cues.text: what is so different?
cues.en: what is so different?
cues.zh: 你們的差別在哪？

cues.text: How do people like Faizal do it?
cues.en: How do people like Faizal do it?
cues.zh: 法扎爾這樣的人是怎麼做到的？

cues.text: To answer that question,
cues.en: To answer that question,
cues.zh: 要回答這個問題

cues.text: I'm going to take you back about 10 years, okay?
cues.en: I'm going to take you back about 10 years, okay?
cues.zh: 要先說說我 10 年前發生的事情

cues.text: I was training staff at that time,
cues.en: I was training staff at that time,
cues.zh: 當年我在訓練員工

cues.text: and my daughter, at that time, was taking piano lessons.
cues.en: and my daughter, at that time, was taking piano lessons.
cues.zh: 而我女兒在上鋼琴課

cues.text: And I started to notice two really strong similarities
cues.en: And I started to notice two really strong similarities
cues.zh: 我開始發現兩個極大的相似之處

cues.text: between my daughter's attitude or thinking towards playing the piano
cues.en: between my daughter's attitude or thinking towards playing the piano
cues.zh: 從我女兒學鋼琴的態度思維

cues.text: and a lot of Malaysians' thinking or attitude towards English.
cues.en: and a lot of Malaysians' thinking or attitude towards English.
cues.zh: 和多數馬來西亞人學英文的態度思維

cues.text: First of all, I should tell you
cues.en: First of all, I should tell you
cues.zh: 首先，我要告訴你

cues.text: my daughter absolutely hated piano,
cues.en: my daughter absolutely hated piano,
cues.zh: 我女兒非常痛恨鋼琴

cues.text: hated the lessons,
cues.en: hated the lessons,
cues.zh: 討厭上課

cues.text: hated practicing.
cues.en: hated practicing.
cues.zh: 討厭練琴

cues.text: This is my daughter practicing piano, okay?
cues.en: This is my daughter practicing piano, okay?
cues.zh: 這是我女兒練琴的樣子

cues.text: This is as good as it got.
cues.en: This is as good as it got.
cues.zh: 她這樣已經算是好的了

cues.text: This is the real thing.
cues.en: This is the real thing.
cues.zh: 是真的

cues.text: And she dreaded going to piano lessons
cues.en: And she dreaded going to piano lessons
cues.zh: 她討厭上鋼琴課

cues.text: because to my daughter, going to piano lessons,
cues.en: because to my daughter, going to piano lessons,
cues.zh: 對我女兒來說，上鋼琴課

cues.text: she was filled with this sort of dread.
cues.en: she was filled with this sort of dread.
cues.zh: 讓她恐慌不安

cues.text: Because it was all about not screwing up, right?
cues.en: Because it was all about not screwing up, right?
cues.zh: 因為要小心翼翼不能搞砸，對吧？

cues.text: Because like a lot of piano students,
cues.en: Because like a lot of piano students,
cues.zh: 就像大多數上鋼琴課的學生

cues.text: to both my daughter and her teacher,
cues.en: to both my daughter and her teacher,
cues.zh: 包括我的女兒跟她的鋼琴老師

cues.text: her success in piano was measured by how few mistakes she made.
cues.en: her success in piano was measured by how few mistakes she made.
cues.zh: 她在鋼琴上的成就 是由出錯的多寡來衡量

cues.text: At the same time,
cues.en: At the same time,
cues.zh: 同時我也發現大多數的 馬來西亞人遇到說英文的場合時

cues.text: I noticed that a lot of Malaysians went into English conversations
cues.en: I noticed that a lot of Malaysians went into English conversations
cues.zh: 同時我也發現大多數的 馬來西亞人遇到說英文的場合時

cues.text: with the same sort of feeling of dread.
cues.en: with the same sort of feeling of dread.
cues.zh: 也是抱著同樣的恐懼

cues.text: This sort of feeling that they were going to be judged
cues.en: This sort of feeling that they were going to be judged
cues.zh: 害怕被別人批評

cues.text: by how many mistakes they were going to make,
cues.en: by how many mistakes they were going to make,
cues.zh: 他究竟犯了多少錯誤

cues.text: and whether or not they were going to screw up.
cues.en: and whether or not they were going to screw up.
cues.zh: 無論他們是否真的搞砸了

cues.text: Now, the second similarity that I noticed was to do with self- image.
cues.en: Now, the second similarity that I noticed was to do with self- image.
cues.zh: 第二個相似處是跟自我意象有關

cues.text: My daughter, she knew what good piano sounded like, right?
cues.en: My daughter, she knew what good piano sounded like, right?
cues.zh: 我女兒知道傑出的鋼琴演奏 聽起來該是什麼樣子，對吧？

cues.text: Because we've all heard good piano.
cues.en: Because we've all heard good piano.
cues.zh: 因為我們都聽過優美的琴聲

cues.text: And she knew what her level was,
cues.en: And she knew what her level was,
cues.zh: 她知道自己的水準在哪裡

cues.text: and she knew how long she'd have to play for to play like that.
cues.en: and she knew how long she'd have to play for to play like that.
cues.zh: 她明白自己要再練很久的琴 才有辦法達到那般高超的境界

cues.text: And a lot of Malaysians, I noticed,
cues.en: And a lot of Malaysians, I noticed,
cues.zh: 我注意到很多馬來西亞人

cues.text: had this idea of what good proper English is supposed to sound like,
cues.en: had this idea of what good proper English is supposed to sound like,
cues.zh: 也有這種認為 流利的英文該怎麼說的想法

cues.text: and what their - I see a lot of you nod -
cues.en: and what their - I see a lot of you nod -
cues.zh: 還有他們…我看到很多人點頭

cues.text: and what their English sounded like,
cues.en: and what their English sounded like,
cues.zh: 還有他們說的英文聽起來如何

cues.text: and how far they would have to go to get there.
cues.en: and how far they would have to go to get there.
cues.zh: 認為自己還有一段很長的路要努力

cues.text: And they also felt like they were - like my daughter - just bad,
cues.en: And they also felt like they were - like my daughter - just bad,
cues.zh: 他們覺得自己是 就像我女兒一樣，覺得差人一等

cues.text: bad piano player, bad English speaker, right?
cues.en: bad piano player, bad English speaker, right?
cues.zh: 鋼琴彈得很糟，英文說得很爛，對吧？

cues.text: My English not so good, lah. Cannot. Sorry, yah. Cannot. Ah -
cues.en: My English not so good, lah. Cannot. Sorry, yah. Cannot. Ah -
cues.zh: 我的英文說的不好啦 沒辦法，抱歉喔，沒辦法啦

cues.text: So I could see these similarities,
cues.en: So I could see these similarities,
cues.zh: 我看到這些相似之處

cues.text: but I still couldn't figure out,
cues.en: but I still couldn't figure out,

cues.text: okay, what is it about these people like Faizal, that are so different,
cues.en: okay, what is it about these people like Faizal, that are so different,
cues.zh: 好吧，所以到底是什麼 讓法扎爾這樣的人如此特別

cues.en: that can just do it smoothly, calmly, with confidence?
cues.zh: 能夠流暢、冷靜沉著 又有自信的說英文？

cues.text: They're really gross.

cues.text: They're smelly, and they're filled with boys.

cues.text: as a lack of confidence in your ability to do the job, to perform.
cues.en: as a lack of confidence in your ability to do the job, to perform.
cues.zh: 你沒有自信能完成這份工作 沒辦法有所表現

cues.text: So if you want to speak English like Faizal with that great confidence,
cues.en: So if you want to speak English like Faizal with that great confidence,
cues.zh: 如果你想跟法扎爾一樣 帶著滿滿的自信開口說英文

cues.text: here's the one thing that you can do.
cues.en: here's the one thing that you can do.
cues.zh: 你可以做一件事

cues.text: When you speak, don't focus on yourself.
cues.en: When you speak, don't focus on yourself.
cues.zh: 說話得時候不要專注在自身

cues.text: Focus on the other person and the result you want to achieve.
cues.en: Focus on the other person and the result you want to achieve.
cues.zh: 而是專注在跟你對談的人 專注於你想表達的想法

cues.text: Imagine a next generation of Malaysians,
cues.en: Imagine a next generation of Malaysians,
cues.zh: 想像下一代馬來西亞人

cues.text: all with that wonderful confidence in communication that Faizal has,
cues.en: all with that wonderful confidence in communication that Faizal has,
cues.zh: 都能自信滿滿的像法扎爾一樣說英文

cues.text: at any level of English.
cues.en: at any level of English.
cues.zh: 無論英文程度高低

cues.text: Because let's remember
cues.en: Because let's remember
cues.zh: 記住

cues.text: that English today is not an art to be mastered,
cues.en: that English today is not an art to be mastered,
cues.zh: 現今英文不是需受評比的藝術

cues.text: it's just a tool to use to get a result.
cues.en: it's just a tool to use to get a result.
cues.zh: 英文只是溝通的工具

cues.text: And that tool belongs to you.
cues.en: And that tool belongs to you.
cues.zh: 你手握這項工具

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
cues.zh: （掌聲）
